world.title: US costs of Iran war rise to over $47 billion, according to Pentagon estimate
world.description: By Phil StewartWASHINGTON, Oct 27 (Reuters) - The US military has spent over $47 billion so far to prosecute the war in Iran, more than 25% higher than the Defense Department's estimate in July, according to Pentagon data obtained by Reuters.The Pentagon did not immediately respond to a request for comment on its estimate, which has not been shared publicly.

science.title: Scientists discover the immune system’s hidden sense of touch
science.description: Scientists at McGill University have discovered a surprising new ability of immune cells that could change how we understand long-term immunity. Researchers found that T cells can actually sense how stiff their surrounding tissues are, using these physical signals to help determine whether they develop into long-lasting memory cells that protect against future infections.
